title: Analista De Custo Em Serviços Sênior - Petz Holding
description:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;

title: Iot Solution Manager
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive IoT Solution Manager to join our São Paulo office.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for IoT (Internet of Things) solutions and services development, CMP (Connectivity Management Platform) operations, and M2M solutions with primary focus on the Brazilian market. Support global connectivity solutions portfolio review, roadmap definition, new solution planning, and daily operations. Provide support to sales and cross-functional teams for both new and existing IoT solutions in Brazil.
  • Manage relationships with Mobile Carriers (MNO/MVNO) in Brazil, aligned with global partnership strategies. Responsible for supplier ecosystem management and for establishing stable and long-term cooperative relationships with key local and global partners supporting the Brazilian operation.
  • Support daily IoT projects in Brazil, handling end-to-end activities including customer communication, requirements analysis, supplier coordination, solution design, quotation preparation, and service delivery.
  • Act as the main interface between the Brazilian operation and headquarters, and with regional offices when required, to align on key industry solutions — including but not limited to IoT, 5G and industry applications, and cloud network solutions — and to promote the localization, implementation, and replication of mature products and solutions within CMI Brazil.


Requirements:

  • Educational background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Telecommunications, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Work experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in telecommunications or IT-related industries, with solid knowledge of Planning, Control, Project Management, and Vendor Management.
  • Professional skills: Strong knowledge of B2B IoT / M2M services, eSIM, CMP, and mobile network solutions. Familiarity with networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, and VPNs.
  • Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and a strong team player.
  • Fluent English.
  • Mandarin Chinese is a plus.


Work Model:

This is an on-site position based in São Paulo, with the possibility of occasional business travel.

  • Experience deploying AI/ML models into production environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

We’re an AI-first, engineering-driven organization helping enterprises accelerate transformation by embedding intelligence into core operations. Our teams combine data science, software engineering, and strategic insight to deliver scalable AI systems that unlock business value and reimagine how organizations operate.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.


As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
The ideal candidate is a strong motivated expert with deep knowledge of the Brazilian automotive distribution sector, strong business development capabilities, and negotiation skills. also Able to face rejection and challenges when pioneering a new market.

Responsibilities

1. Network Development and Planning

Conduct in-depth analysis of the Brazilian automotive market landscape, consumer preferences, and competitor network layouts.

Develop a sales network development blueprint (city selection, network density, partner profile) aligned with our brand positioning and market objectives.

2. Potential Partner Development and Screening

Proactively identify, screen, and build a database of potential dealership investors.

Target high-quality partners through various channels including industry connections, exhibitions, associations, and commercial data.

3. Business Negotiation and Contract Signing

Lead all business negotiations with potential dealers, clearly communicating our brand value, product planning, commercial policies, and support systems.

Prepare investment proposals, contract documents, and finalize the signing of dealer authorization agreements.

4. Store Setup Support and Acceptance

Guide and support newly contracted dealers in completing store construction or renovation according to BAIC's global CI/VI standards and local Brazilian requirements.

Coordinate internal resources to provide support to dealers in areas such as team building, system installation (DMS), and initial inventory preparation.

5. Dealer Relationship Management and Performance Support

Serve as the primary interface between dealers and the company, building and maintaining solid, mutually trusting cooperative relationships.

Assist new dealers in launching operations and continuously monitor their sales, marketing, and after-sales performance.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields
  • Proficient in Portuguese and English , capable of using them as working languages for professional negotiations and written communication (Chinese is a significant plus).
  • At least 5 years of work experience in the Brazilian automotive industry , of which 3+ years must be focused on automotive dealership network development, dealership management, or large B2B sales management .
  • Possess an established network of Brazilian automotive dealership investors and industry connections .
  • Possess excellent business negotiation, financial analysis, and contract management skills.
  • Outstanding presentation skills and interpersonal skills, able to represent the brand and communicate effectively with senior business professionals.
  • Able to travel frequently, covering Brazil's core cities.

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.


Our client is a growing Brazilian fintech with strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).


Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel;
    (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent;
    (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes;
    (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Delivery Engineer (Quality & Safety By Design)
description:
ZTE Is looking for Delivery Engineer (Quality & Safety by Design)

Role Overview

We are hiring a Delivery Engineer to act as the engineering reference for post-sales delivery execution in complex telecommunications infrastructure projects.

This is a hands-on, operational role , focused on engineering decision-making, delivery feasibility, execution quality, and safety embedded by design .

It is not a people-management role and not a pre-sales position .

The mission is to ensure that what was sold can be installed, integrated, commissioned, accepted, and operated successfully in real environments , right the first time .


Key Responsibilities

  • Validate, review, and approve provisional and definitive engineering designs (PPI, TSSR, PDI, FAM, As-Built), ensuring technical consistency across the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure delivery designs comply with customer engineering standards , contractual technical scope , vendor global guidelines , and real site constraints (space, power, grounding, access, structural conditions).
  • Act as the engineering reference for delivery feasibility , identifying gaps, risks, or assumptions that could impact execution, quality, cost, or schedule.
  • Define, validate, and approve the Engineering / Installation Bill of Materials (E-BOM) , ensuring completeness and technical adequacy for installation, integration, and commissioning activities.
  • Classify materials and requirements clearly as included , assumptions , or out-of-scope / change-required , supporting transparent scope control.
  • Validate the engineering quality of executed installations , ensuring alignment with approved designs, customer standards, and best engineering practices.
  • Review and approve installation quality and acceptance evidence , including photos, checklists, test results, quality reports, and as-built documentation.
  • Decide, from an engineering standpoint, on installation acceptance, required corrections, or rework , based on objective technical criteria.
  • Embed quality and safety as engineering premises (quality & safety by design ), ensuring designs and E-BOMs support safe and reliable execution.
  • Identify delivery, integration, and acceptance risks early, proposing engineering mitigations to prevent rework, delays, and SLA impact.
  • Act as the engineering focal point in customer design reviews, technical workshops, and acceptance discussions , representing delivery engineering interests.
  • Interface with HSE/EHS, Quality, PMO, Billing, Presales and Field teams from an engineering perspective, translating requirements into executable design and delivery decisions.
  • Support technical clarification, deviation analysis, and root-cause discussions related to delivery execution and installation quality.

This role does not perform field supervision and does not assume legal HSE responsibilities.


What This Role Is Not

  • Not pre-sales or solution definition
  • Not people management
  • Not field supervision or safety technician

This role drives engineering decisions , not day-to-day execution control.


Profile & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering , or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in telecommunications delivery engineering within vendor, operator, or system integrator environments.
  • Practical exposure to one or more domains: RAN, IP, Microwave, Optical, DCN .
  • Strong understanding of installation, integration, commissioning, and real-world execution constraints .
  • Postgraduate specialization in Occupational Safety, Risk Management, Quality, or Compliance
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) relevant to telecom infrastructure projects, such as NR-1, NR-6, NR-7, NR-10, and NR-35.
  • Familiarity with occupational safety procedures and documentation (e.G., basic understanding of PT/APR concepts), from an engineering and feasibility perspective.
  • English – Mandatory (primary working language)
  • Portuguese – Fluent or Native
  • Mandarin – Desirable


Why This Role Matters

Because delivery success depends on engineering decisions made before problems reach the field .


This role ensures that:

  • delivery designs are executable in practice,
  • quality is built into engineering decisions,
  • safety is considered by design,
  • customer acceptance is predictable and auditable.


If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (Bsc/Rnc), Oss And Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.


Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.



Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.

Formação:

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.


The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of supplier-manufactured components and systems used in RNG equipment. This role leads supplier qualification, audits, testing, and continuous improvement activities to maintain high quality standards across the supply chain.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Qualify, audit, and develop suppliers to ensure robust manufacturing and quality systems (NCR, CAPA, PPAP/APQP).
  • Assess supplier manufacturing capability and mitigate quality and delivery risks.
  • Drive supplier performance improvement aligned with quality, cost, and delivery targets.
  • Lead product and process qualification activities at supplier sites.
  • Plan and execute FAT and SAT activities for components and fully assembled RNG systems.
  • Review test procedures, validate instrumentation, document non-conformances, and issue acceptance reports.
  • Develop and implement inspection plans, test procedures, SOPs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage non-conforming supplier components and oversee root cause investigations using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa).
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable codes and standards (ASME, ASTM, AWS, NR13).
  • Identify cost reduction and quality improvement opportunities with supply chain and engineering teams.
  • Lead Kaizen and standardized work initiatives at supplier facilities.
  • Maintain accurate records of supplier processes, audits, test results, and corrective actions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, databooks, and management reports.
  • Partner with internal teams (manufacturing, purchasing, QA/QC).
  • Train and mentor quality personnel on qualification, testing, and inspection processes.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years in manufacturing or quality roles;
    1–3+ years in Supplier Quality Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of integrated process systems (e.G., gas processing, upgrading systems, controls).
  • Strong technical capability with Supplier audits, FAT/SAT leadership, GD&T, P&ID interpretation, ISO 9001, root cause analysis.
  • Preferred with knowledge in standards as ASTM A516 Gr.70, ABNT NBR 6656 USI SAC 50, ABNT NR-12, NR-13, ASME VIII Div.1, ISO 2768-mK, MTC EN 10204 Type 3.1, ANSI class, AWS A2.4, ASTM A36, ABNT NBR 7007 MR250, and SSPC-SP6/SP10.
  • Experience working directly with customers and plant operators in on-site environments.
  • Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to leadership.
  • English proficiency required.


How to Apply:


We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures, including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.Js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Consultor (A) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:


  • Advanced English


  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.


  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.


  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.


  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.


  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.


  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.


  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.


  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades


  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment


  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.


  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.


  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS


  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.


  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.


  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.


Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)



1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.


2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.


3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.


4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.


5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.


6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.


7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.


8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.


9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.


10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.


11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.


12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.


13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.


14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.


15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.


16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.


17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.


18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.


19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.


20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.


The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for defining, optimizing, and sustaining safe, efficient, and repeatable manufacturing and testing processes for large Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) equipment. This role ensures manufacturing operations consistently meet Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery (SQCD) objectives through structured process design, documentation, and continuous improvement.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize assembly processes for large RNG equipment, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and safety requirements.
  • Develop and maintain assembly procedures, work instructions, SOPs, and control plans.
  • Lead the transition from engineering to production, ensuring tooling, documentation, training, and test readiness.
  • Develop and execute testing protocols to validate equipment performance, safety, and compliance.
  • Analyze, document, and report test results in accordance with applicable standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement to enhance testing accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Industrial Engineering principles (time studies, capacity modeling, line balancing, takt analysis).
  • Lead Kaizen events, value stream mapping, 5S, standardized work, and waste reduction initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analysis (A3, 5 Whys, Fishbone) and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure manufacturing processes comply with internal quality standards and external regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct audits and inspections of manufacturing and testing activities.
  • Support incoming inspection, non-conformance management, and corrective action processes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance).
  • Train and mentor manufacturing personnel on processes, safety, and best practices.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–8+ years in manufacturing or industrial engineering;
    2–4+ years in Lean/process improvement roles.
  • Strong understanding of integrated process systems (e.G., gas processing, upgrading systems, controls).
  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma (Green Belt preferred), and data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI, Minitab)
  • Preferred with knowledge in standards as ASTM A516 Gr.70, ABNT NBR 6656 USI SAC 50, ABNT NR-12, NR-13, ASME VIII Div.1, ISO 2768-mK, MTC EN 10204 Type 3.1, ANSI class, AWS A2.4, ASTM A36, ABNT NBR 7007 MR250, and SSPC-SP6/SP10.
  • Experience working directly with customers and plant operators in on-site environments.
  • Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to senior leadership.
  • English proficiency required.


How to Apply:


We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Gerente Ativos Vendas/Rentabilidade (Freezers Alocados)
description:
Se você gosta de estruturar decisões que conectam operação, dados e impacto financeiro, e de transformar ativos físicos em verdadeiras alavancas de performance no ponto de venda, essa vaga é para você!


Aqui, cada equipamento corretamente alocado, cada contrato bem gerido e cada ação de manutenção bem coordenada fazem diferença direta na eficiência do parque de equipamentos, na atratividade da marca para o consumidor final e no potencial de vendas em cada PDV.


Seu papel será garantir que o “parque de equipamentos alocados” opere no máximo do seu potencial, conectando vendas, rentabilidade, gestão de contratos e performance técnica dos freezers. Você atuará de forma integrada com times de manutenção para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento dos equipamentos, evitando rupturas, perdas de venda e impactos na experiência do cliente.


Além disso, terá um olhar analítico para entender onde cada equipamento gera mais retorno, como otimizar realocações, priorizar manutenções e apoiar decisões que aumentem a rentabilidade do negócio de forma sustentável.


No seu dia a dia você vai:

  • Gestão de Contratos (SLA): Monitorar e auditar o cumprimento dos serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva realizados pela 3L, gerenciando o contrato de locação e manutenção, garantindo o tempo de resposta (Uptime) adequado.
  • Análise de Negócio: Realizar estudos financeiros comparativos entre compra (Capex) e aluguel (Opex), avaliando impactos em depreciação, fluxo de caixa e impostos.
  • Controle Patrimonial: Gerir o inventário dos +12.000 equipamentos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a correta alocação nos PDVs.
  • Gestão de Eficiência: Monitorar o consumo energético e a performance técnica das conservadoras para garantir a qualidade do Gelato Bacio (padrão -18°C).
  • Planejamento de Expansão: Dimensionar a necessidade de novos equipamentos conforme o plano de expansão da marca.
  • Gestão de Sinistros: Definir fluxos para casos de perda, roubo ou danos críticos aos equipamentos junto ao fornecedor, clientes e distribuidores.
  • Gestão de Rentabilidade por Ativo (ROI/Freezer ): Calcular e monitorar mensalmente a rentabilidade de cada equipamento, cruzando os custos de locação e energia com o volume de vendas do PDV, para identificar conservadoras subutilizadas ou deficitárias.
  • Gestão de Capex vs. Opex (Buy or Lease ): Elaborar modelos financeiros complexos para fundamentar decisões de negócio entre a continuidade do aluguel com a 3L ou a aquisição de frota própria (Fricon), considerando depreciação, custo de oportunidade e manutenção.
  • Otimização Logística e Reversa: Coordenar a movimentação e o remanejamento estratégico de freezers entre pontos de venda, priorizando locais com maior giro para maximizar o retorno sobre o custo fixo de locação.
  • Auditoria de Eficiência Energética e Sustentabilidade: Implementar programas de monitoramento de consumo elétrico nas conservadoras para reduzir o custo operacional indireto e alinhar o parque de equipamentos às metas de sustentabilidade da empresa.
  • Gestão de Ciclo de Vida e Renovação Tecnológica: Planejar o cronograma de renovação do parque tecnológico, garantindo que equipamentos antigos (com maior índice de manutenção preventiva/corretiva) sejam substituídos por modelos mais eficientes e rentáveis.


E quais os requisitos para trabalhar conosco?

  1. Nível Superior Completo (Engenharia, Administração ou Economia).
  2. Experiência sólida em gestão de ativos (contratos), conhecimento em manutenção de refrigeração industrial ou gestão de frotas/equipamentos. (mandatório)
  3. Foco em vendas por equipamento (eficiência) e necessidade de locação/movimentação.
  4. Facilidade de interação e senso de urgência e acompanhamento junto ao time de Manutenção
  5. Conhecimento em ciclo de refrigeração, análise de TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) e gestão de contratos de terceiros.
  6. Conhecimento em Gestão de Ativos Físicos e noções de normas regulamentadoras de refrigeração.
  7. Excel Avançado (Modelagem financeira), SAP ou ERPs de gestão de ativos e ferramentas de geolocalização.
  8. Domínio de P&L (mandatório)
  9. Diferencial: Inglês Intermediário (Para benchmarking de novos fornecedores/tecnologias).


E sabe quais benefícios você terá conosco?

  • Seu bônus/PLR será baseado no seu atingimento de metas e poderá chegar em até 5 salários a partir do mês seguinte a sua admissão;

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack - Pleno / Senior
description:

Nossas tecnologias:

  • React
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • React Native
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Node.Js
  • GraphQL
  • Sequelize
  • Next.Js
  • PostgreSQL
  • Docker
  • AWS
  • Serverless
  • Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (Event-Driven)


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web e móveis robustas e escaláveis.
  • Participar ativamente em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a análise até a implementação e testes.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir, projetar e implementar novas funcionalidades e soluções para nossos clientes.
  • Otimizar aplicações e promover melhorias contínuas em nossos produtos.

  • Contribuir para o aprendizado contínuo da equipe e para o seu próprio desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Vivência com as stacks que utilizamos na empresa.
  • Residir em Santa Catarina (para facilitar os encontros estratégicos).


Detalhes da vaga:

  • Modelo de trabalho: O trabalho é de forma remota / mas fazemos de forma Híbrida, apenas encontros presenciais mensais para reuniões estratégicas em Blumenau - SC ou localizações próximas.

title: Gerente Júnior - Programa Select | São Paulo Capital E Interior
description:
OPORTUNIDADE NAS ÁREAS : COMERCIAL, LOGÍSTICA E FINANCEIRO.

Trabalho 100% presencial


CONHEÇA A AMBEV


ENTRE PARA UM TIME QUE SONHA TÃO GRANDE COMO VOCÊ!


Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! Nosso sucesso é compartilhado e acreditamos que por meio da colaboração podemos encantar ainda mais o nossos clientes com as marcas que eles amam hoje, ao mesmo tempo em que podemos atender aos gostos de amanhã.


A Nossa Cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas - e nos ajudar a ser a nossa melhor versão! Procuramos gente com paixão, curiosidade e coragem para fazer a diferença aqui.


Acolhemos talentos diversos, porque acreditamos que grandes ideias vêm de pessoas com diferentes trajetórias. Oferecemos oportunidades para talentos que estão ingressando no mercado de trabalho e somos apaixonados por impulsionar a nossa gente.


DESCRIÇÃO DO PROGRAMA


O Programa Regional Select engloba todas as áreas do Mundo Vendas , incluindo Comercial, Logística 2º e 3º Tier e Financeiro. O programa tem duração aproximada de 1 a 2 meses e visa à formação dos futuros líderes. Durante o treinamento, você fica imerso nas diferentes áreas do negócio e conhece algumas de nossas operações.


Além de aprender na prática, você permanece próximo a líderes que oferecem apoio para o seu desenvolvimento de carreira e para assumir novos desafios.


Esse programa possui um plano de treinamento amplo, com uma visão holística da companhia. Ao final do treinamento, o candidato, juntamente com o nosso time, define sua área de alocação. As áreas da Geo SP – Mundo Vendas incluem: vendas, nível de serviço, gente e gestão, financeiro e logística. Além disso, contamos com times especializados em produtos não alcoólicos, preços, processos e cervejas premium.

A alocação ocorre após o período de treinamento, podendo ser em Centros de Distribuição ou no Escritório Regional.


O QUE É O MUNDO VENDAS NA AMBEV?


Na prática, o Mundo Vendas é a área responsável por fazer nossos produtos chegarem a mais de um milhão de pontos de venda no Brasil, além de cuidar do desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas no ambiente comercial. É a área que garante que a cerveja do boteco do seu Zé, o Guaraná Antarctica do restaurante da esquina ou as bebidas de grandes eventos como Lollapalooza, Carnaval e Copa do Mundo estejam sempre disponíveis e geladas.

Durante o treinamento, os participantes passam por um mergulho em vendas, para que Talentos e Selects compreendam o mercado, a segmentação comercial e como atendemos, com qualidade, milhões de consumidores.


REQUISITOS


  • Experiência Sugerida:

Capacidade de liderar equipes;

Facilidade de comunicação;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Capacidade analítica;

Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;

Disposição para trabalhos externos.


  • Formação:

Ensino superior completo.

Desejável experiência em vendas e gestão de equipe.


  • Exigência:
  • CNH B definitiva, com limite de 8 pontos e sem multas gravíssimas.


BENEFÍCIOS


Hoje na AMBEV nós trabalhamos com os melhores benefícios para você e também para os seus dependentes legais! Aqui na companhia nós conseguimos te proporcionar:


  • Mais cuidado com a sua saúde através de Plano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina, Seguro de Vida e Wellhub.
  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa.
  • Consumir nossos produtos com um super desconto (é isso mesmo, nós temos venda de produtos para funcionários no precinho! )
  • Reuniões de final de ano com a família ainda mais prazerosas, pois oferecemos Cesta de Natal e ainda brinquedo para quem tem filhos
  • Proteção financeira com a nossa previdência privada
  • A possibilidade de você fazer um bom mercado ou comer no restaurante que você gosta com Vale Alimentação ou Refeição , pois você poderá optar por um destes benefícios
  • O vale transporte é opcional e você pode conferir no modelo da vaga
  • Ter a oportunidade de receber um abono assiduidade, que nada mais é do que o 14º salário para nossos colaboradores, um salário extra no ano!
  • Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio babá
  • Participação dos Lucros da companhia


VENHA FAZER PARTE DO TIME

title: 2026 global management trainee program - latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world.What’s yours?
Position Overview
The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.
Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.
What you'll do
Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.
Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on
Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.
Qualifications:
To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.
Who you are
Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

Competitive compensation package
Generous benefits package
Paid Time Off
Career developmental opportunities
A company culture that prioritizes internal developmentPlease note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

Em nossa organização, estamos totalmente comprometidos em contribuir para soluções financeiras que tornem a indústria um lugar seguro, acessível e dinâmico. Queremos alcançar diferentes partes do mundo com nosso amplo ecossistema de soluções tecnológicas. Por isso, convidamos você a fazer parte dessa equipe!Além disso, temos ótimos benefícios para você! Sabemos que, juntos, alcançaremos o sucesso, então se candidate e faça parte desse grande time.Seu dia a dia na Topaz:
A equipeImplementation Tech Payé formada por profissionais dedicados à sustentação de produtos de renda variável, com ênfase no mercado de ações e derivativos. Nossa missão é assegurar que os sistemas funcionem de maneira otimizada e eficiente, proporcionando um suporte de excelência aos nossos clientes. Desta forma, as atividades do dia a dia são:Analisar, desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações em Java de alto nível para clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, garantindo elevados padrões de segurança, desempenho, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário.
Documentar detalhadamente todo o código e os processos técnicos associados.
Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (especialmente sob a metodologia Scrum) e colaborar diretamente com outros times técnicos (Backend, QA, Design, Produto).
Pesquisar e propor soluções técnicas inovadoras, demonstrando autonomia, capacidade de resolver problemas e proatividade.
Manter comunicação efetiva e clara com clientes internos e externos sempre que necessário.
Utilizar, promover e apoiar-se ativamente em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial fornecidas pela Stefanini, adotando uma mentalidade de melhoria contínua e otimização por meio de IA.O que você precisa conhecer para ser parte da Topaz?
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (Java 8+), incluindo fundamentos avançados de orientação a objetos.
Experiência em desenvolvimento front-end (Angular), permitindo atuação em entregas end-to-end.
Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de sobreaviso quinzenalmente.
Vivência com aplicações corporativas utilizando Wildfly, REST, SOAP, Jasper Reports e padrões de integração.
Experiência em modelagem de dados, criação e otimização de queries SQL para SQL Server.
Conhecimento de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) com JUnit e Mockito.
Capacidade de analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar problemas em ambiente de produção, propondo correções seguras e sustentáveis.
Familiaridade com Git e práticas de versionamento aplicadas em times ágeis.
Noções de arquitetura de sistemas, design de APIs, segurança, desempenho e boas práticas de integração.
Diferenciais:Experiência em desenvolvimento ou manutenção de aplicações de alta transacionalidade e para grandes volumes de usuários | Experiência em processos de automação, CI/CD e Dev Ops (desejável).

title: Comprador
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Comprador para se juntar à nossa equipe em São Paulo. Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).
Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)Quais serão suas principais funções?
Analisar o comportamento do mercado, tendências, preços e riscos na categoria de Alimentos.
Definir estratégias de curto, médio e longo prazo para as famílias com maior representatividade econômica dentro da categoria de Alimentos.
Buscar novos fornecedores e parceiros estratégicos que nos ajudem a otimizar e diversificar as alternativas de produtos nas principais famílias da categoria de Alimentos.
Apoiar na preparação e execução de licitações e leilões estratégicos.
Realizar cotações, negociar preços e condições com fornecedores para otimizar custos e melhorar os indicadores do departamento.
Elaborar comparativos de propostas para a tomada de decisões.
Conseguir, nas principais negociações com fornecedores, ampliar o escopo do departamento de compras (Rappel).
Identificar oportunidades de economia, eficiência e consolidação de fornecedores.
Desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com fornecedores chave.
Atuar como ponto de contato entre o departamento de compras e os responsáveis de FB.
Liderar planos de ação para reduzir custos totais e otimizar o portfólio de fornecedores.
Trabalhar com os departamentos envolvidos para definir especificações e demandas reais.
Alinhar as decisões de compra com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
Participar de reuniões de planejamento de demanda, IPC e reuniões globais.
Avaliar e melhorar continuamente os processos de compra, garantindo eficiência em custos e prazos de entrega.
Monitorar e reportar indicadores chave de desempenho (KPIs), como tempos de contratação e qualidade do fornecimento.
Acompanhar e monitorar os pedidos.
Garantir que as aquisições estejam em conformidade com os padrões de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade corporativa.
Trabalhar com os fornecedores para promover práticas mais responsáveis na cadeia de suprimentos.
Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas internas e de compliance nas compras.O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?
Formação: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
Experiência: De 2 a 3 anos em compras, suprimentos ou gestão de categorias nos setores hoteleiro, varejo ou bens de consumo. Experiência em gestão operacional de compras e negociação com fornecedores
Domínio de plataformas de gestão de compras (SAP Ariba, Oracle ou similares).
Capacidade de elaborar comparativos de preços, analisar custos e propor melhorias.
Experiência na negociação de condições comerciais, contratos e acordos com fornecedores.
Comunicação eficaz com fornecedores e equipes internas para a gestão do dia a dia.
Orientação para a eficiência operacional, cumprimento de prazos de entrega e otimização de custos.
Capacidade de lidar com incidentes envolvendo fornecedores e coordenar soluções com outras áreas.
Atitude proativa e colaboração com a equipe de compras e demais departamentos.IdiomasPortuguês e espanhol avançado.
Inglês básico intermediário.Alguns dos nossos benefícios:
Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.
Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com benefícios atrativos.
Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial e crescer profissionalmente

title: Product owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY
JOB DESCRIPTION
The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.
Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.
Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.
Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.
Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.
Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.
Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.
Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.
Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.
Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.
Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.
Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Perform other job-related functions as assigned.QUALIFICATIONS
DEGREE TYPE:
Bachelor's DegreeFIELD(S) OF STUDY:
Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fieldsEXPERIENCE;
At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.COMPETENCIES/SKILLS
Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environmentsCERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES
Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

description:
Job Description:We are seeking an Electrical Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment.
Proficiency with electrical design software (e.g., CAD, simulation tools) and testing equipment.
Strong knowledge of electrical safety standards and product certification processes.
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.Differentials:
Experience in the home appliance, HVAC, or durable goods industries.
Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development.
Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management.
Advanced English proficiency.

Clear release management process with well-set approval stages, setting up automatic gates that move applications from one phase to another until they are available to customers, and supporting the evolution of these processes to make them controlled, scalable, and repeatable.

Following the implementation of observability as well as actionable alerts, and full visibility of application performance and the underlying infrastructures.The Regional Cloud Dev Ops will have the responsibility to manage and provide guidance to the local infrastructure and development teams on:• Guidance and support in the migration activities of local infrastructure and solutions to the cloud for all regional countries.

• Ensuring that a secure development approach is followed across the region.You’re a matchThe ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in a Dev Ops role managing IT Infrastructures with Cloud platforms in an international environment, and a background in Development and cloud Fin Ops experience will be valuable. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities:
Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.

Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
Prior experience in crypto is a must.
10+ years' experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
Strong understanding of Brazil's crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).

Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.
Vision & Mission:
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Head of finance, brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.
We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.JOB DESCRIPTION
The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic & Financial Leadership
Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long-range planning processes for Brazil.
Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit-ready, always” standards.
Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
Own end-to-end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.Performance Management & Business Partnering
Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost-to-serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitabilityInternal Controls, Governance & Risk Management
Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
Lead governance of Fixed-asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3 PL and distributor consignment)
Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.Systems, ERP & Digital Finance
Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision-making.Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline
Foster effective cross-functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.QUALIFICATIONS
Experience
Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.Skills & Competencies
Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP
Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision-makers.
Strong systems orientation, with hands-on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.Education & Credentials
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

title: Supplier quality engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.
The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of supplier-manufactured components and systems used in RNG equipment. This role leads supplier qualification, audits, testing, and continuous improvement activities to maintain high quality standards across the supply chain.Key Duties and Responsibilities:
Qualify, audit, and develop suppliers to ensure robust manufacturing and quality systems (NCR, CAPA, PPAP/APQP).
Assess supplier manufacturing capability and mitigate quality and delivery risks.
Drive supplier performance improvement aligned with quality, cost, and delivery targets.
Lead product and process qualification activities at supplier sites.
Plan and execute FAT and SAT activities for components and fully assembled RNG systems.
Review test procedures, validate instrumentation, document non-conformances, and issue acceptance reports.
Develop and implement inspection plans, test procedures, SOPs, and acceptance criteria.
Manage non-conforming supplier components and oversee root cause investigations using structured methodologies (8 D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa).
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable codes and standards (ASME, ASTM, AWS, NR13).
Identify cost reduction and quality improvement opportunities with supply chain and engineering teams.
Lead Kaizen and standardized work initiatives at supplier facilities.
Maintain accurate records of supplier processes, audits, test results, and corrective actions.
Prepare technical documentation, databooks, and management reports.

description: Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. Join us, let's accelerate the energy transition together.
