title: Influencer video producer
description:
INFLUENCER VIDEO PRODUCER - TECNO
Job Description：
We are looking for an Influencer Video Producer - someone who is not only highly skilled in video production and post-production, but also thrives in the social media ecosystem, especially Tik Tok and emerging short-video platforms. This role combines traditional media production (TVC-level content) with modern social-driven creative execution. You will ideate, shoot, edit and publish engaging videos optimized for social platforms, while also overseeing high-scale commercial productions across Brazil. We are seeking someone who understands Tik Tok and Instagram trends, meme culture, emotional hooks, retention strategies and storytelling formats used by top creators and influencers - someone who genuinely enjoys being online and knows how to make content that captures attention in the first 3 seconds. You will work closely with local teams in Brazil.
Key Responsibilities：
1. Content Ideation & Trend Monitoring: o Research trending sounds, hashtags, formats, memes and storytelling frameworks across Tik Tok, Reels and You Tube Shorts. o Write scripts and develop creative concepts aligned with short-form performance culture.
2. Hands-On Content Creation: o Shoot and edit daily content, from simple clips and vlogs to higher production short films. o Create engaging and polished videos optimized for retention, impact and virality.
3. Influencer-Style Content Execution: o Produce content with an authentic creator tone - dynamic cuts, subtitles, transitions, hooks, POV styles, lifestyle content, product demos, etc.
4. TVC-Level Production & Oversight: o Lead larger-scale shoots, including commercials and branded campaigns. o Manage agency vendors, production teams, freelancers and creative partners across LATAM.
5. Cross-Functional Collaboration: o Work with the Brazilian Tik Tok Live Streaming team and the broader LATAM content team to deliver consistent high-quality video output. o Align content strategy with marketing goals, brand tone and campaign objectives.
6. Cultural Adaptation & Localization: o Ensure all content respects cultural nuances, humor, trends, and sensitivities across different LATAM markets. Job Responsibilities As a content creator, writing the script, find the hottest '#' Topic Trend and work with the team to complete videos based on the most popular Tiktok video content of the moment. Familiar with mobile games and mobile phone industy, able to combine phone games and short videos. Working with the local Brazilian Tiktok Live Streaming Team and LATAM Team to produce daily videos for Infinix, including but not limited to event filming, 2 D animation, trending videos etc. Familiarize yourself with cultures throughout the mobile phone industry or other 3 C industries.
Job Requirements：
5+ years of experience in video shooting and editing (TVC, You Tube, Short-form social content). Expert command of Adobe Premiere, Final Cut or Da Vinci, plus After Effects or motion graphics tools. Strong passion and experience producing short-form content (Tik Tok, Reels, Shorts). Demonstrated ability to follow and anticipate social content trends. Understanding of LATAM culture, audience behavior, digital language and regional sensitivities. Experience in mobile tech or gaming industry is a plus. Access to and experience working with external creative agencies and production partners. Fluent English (speaking/listening required). What We're Looking For You're the right fit if you are: ? Obsessed with content performance and creativity. ? Comfortable in front of and behind the camera (optional, but a plus). ? Able to balance speed, quality and creativity under deadlines. ? A creator at heart - someone who thinks in clips, hooks and edits. Experience as an influencer, content creator or social media editor. Portfolio with viral content or strong engagement history.

title: Sap sd/mm supervisor
description:

Experience in SAP BASIS activities, including system upgrade and SAP OSS Notes applications.
Familiarity with SAP Notes discovery and implementation support
Deep Understanding of Brazil Tax Environment, particularly indirect taxation. Recent tax reform aims to simplify and modernize the tax system by replacing multiple existing taxes (IPI, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ST and FCP) with two new taxes: CBS (Contribution on Goods and Services) and IBS (Tax on Goods and Services).

Collaborate with project teams and business partners during project planning, software delivery reviews, and testing to ensure the software has been implemented according to specifications.

Provide advice, troubleshooting, and guidance for end-user support; identify areas for automation of manual processes and data analytics reporting.
Conduct meetings and deliver presentations; gather critical information to produce useful reports.

Strong communication skills, able to interact with business, regional, and global stakeholders.
Advanced English.

Ability to build relationships and engage effectively with different audiences.

title: Cadista de infraestrutura de transportes
description:
A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo.
Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores.No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. title: Senior backend engineering analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.
Join our development team as aSenior Backend Engineering Analyst!
You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.Activities
While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:
Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company'sstrategic objectives (OKRs), collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
Architect and develop APIsfor incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for arobust, global messaging platform(e.g., Whats App and SMS channels).
Collaboratively develop and enhancedistributed backend servicesthat meet our customers' needs.
Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
Master integrations and communications usingREST APIs.
Practicecode versioning (Git), with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
Work effectively in a teamenvironment-we don't build software alone!Requirements
Experience in a functional language like Elixir, Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure.
Experience developingRESTful and g RPC APIs.
Strong knowledge ofdistributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
Practical knowledge ofAgile development methodologies.
Solid understanding ofrelational databases.
Experience withUnit Testing and Integration Testing.
English is a must.You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.We are looking for people who:
Enjoy working with talented teammates toraise the technical barfor the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
Adapt quicklyto change.
Haveexcellent communication skillsfor interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.
In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizingcontinuous improvementand contributing to the evolution of our products and services.Nice to have:
Knowledge of other languages likeJava and Kotlin.
Experience withdistributed systems and microservices.
Familiarity with container technology (e.g.,Docker and Kubernetes).
Experience with messaging systems (e.g.,Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Phoenix Pub Sub).
Knowledge ofNo SQL databases(e.g., Postgres, My SQL, Redis, Mongo DB, Elastic Search, etc.).Benefits
Stay healthy:We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
Flexible benefits:With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
Family first:Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
Everyday wellbeing:We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
Secure your future: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
Diversity and inclusion:We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
Take a break:Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.Our Hiring Process
In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!
Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur
Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!
O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora
Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Segurança Pública/ Privada ou áreas afins;Domínio de Excel avançado;Domínio de Power Point avançado;Domínio na ferramenta Power BI;Idiomas: Inglês Avançado/ Fluente - (conversação e escrita) obrigatório, Espanhol desejável;Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos;Habilidade em negociação e gestão de fornecedores e parceiros;Experiência em gestão de crises e tomada de decisões rápidas;Disponibilidadetotal para trabalhar em horários flexíveis e finais de semana;Disponibilidadetotal para viagens e permanência por largos períodos em outros estados;Ter CNH e habilidade com direção de veículos;Residir em São Paulo/SP.

description:

Se você é apaixonado pordados, machine learning e IA Generativa, entende o potencial dessas tecnologias para transformar o mercado demídias sociais e criadores de conteúdo, e tem um perfil proativo, analítico e orientado a resultados, queremos conhecer você!Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderar e executar o roadmap estratégico de Data Science e AI, desenvolvendo produtos internos que irão revolucionar nossa operação e a forma como entregamos valor.

Desenvolver e implementar soluções deInteligência Artificial Generativa (Gen AI)para otimizar processos internos e criar novas ferramentas para criadores e marcas (ex: análise preditiva de conteúdo, assistentes de briefing, etc.).
Criar modelos demachine learningpara resolver desafios de negócios, como: previsão de performance de campanhas, sistemas de recomendação de influenciadores (matchmaking), análise de sentimento em larga escala e detecção de tendências.

Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Produto, Marketing e Operações para entender as necessidades de negócios e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Analisar e extrair insights de grandes volumes de dados (estruturados e não estruturados) do ecossistema de mídias sociais.
Apresentar resultados e descobertas complexas de forma clara e acionável para stakeholders (lideranças e equipes não técnicas).Requisitos e Qualificações
Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de Data Science e Machine Learning, com um portfólio de projetos aplicados.
Proficiência em Pythone suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn).
Experiência prática com frameworks de Deep Learning(ex: Tensor Flow, Py Torch).
Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções com LLMs(Large Language Models), fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e ferramentas como Lang Chain ou similares.
Conhecimento sólido emSQLe experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
Experiência em engenharia de dados, construção de pipelines (ETL) e orquestração de jobs (ex: Airflow).
Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de \"traduzir\" o técnico para o negócio.
Perfil analítico, focado em resolução de problemas e orientado a resultados.
Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e suas ferramentas de AI/ML.Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):

title: Executivo comercial hunter para grandes contas - mercado pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!
Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.
Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.
Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:
Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores,e sendo responsável por:
Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;Requisitos:
Possuir graduação completa;
Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2 B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
Possuir carro próprio.Nós lhe propomos:
Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

Conhecimento dequalidade e governança de dados(DQ, MDM/MDG, linagem, reconciliação, conformidade e auditoria).
Vivência commetodologias ágeis(Scrum/Kanban) e gestão de projetos (planeamento, risco, comunicação executiva).

title: Gerente de vendas - campo
description:
Sobre a Mobiis
A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções Saa S para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.O Gerente de Vendas Campo será responsável por liderar, estruturar e escalar a atuação comercial externa da Mobiis, com forte presença junto a clientes e prospects estratégicos. A função terá como principal objetivo impulsionar a geração de receita direta, ampliar a presença da Mobiis em contas enterprise e mid-market e garantir previsibilidade comercial em mercados prioritários. Este papel é essencial para acelerar a adoção das soluções Saa S da Mobiis, atuando de forma próxima ao cliente, conectando estratégia, execução e relacionamento de longo prazo.Resumo da Função
O(a) Gerente de Vendas Campo será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a estratégia de vendas externas da Mobiis, liderando o time de vendedores em campo e atuando diretamente em negociações complexas e de alto valor. A função combina liderança comercial, atuação hands-on em campo e gestão de pipeline, com foco em crescimento sustentável, expansão de carteira, fechamento de grandes contratos e fortalecimento da marca Mobiis junto ao mercado logístico e de tecnologia.Principais Responsabilidades
1. Estratégia Comercial em Campo
• Definir e executar a estratégia de vendas externas, alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da Mobiis.
• Estruturar territórios, rotas, prioridades e segmentos de atuação (mid-market e enterprise).
• Garantir execução consistente do plano comercial em campo, com foco em eficiência e resultado.2. Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Fechamento
• Atuar diretamente na prospecção, negociação e fechamento de negócios estratégicos, especialmente em ciclos de venda mais complexos.
• Conduzir reuniões presenciais, apresentações executivas e negociações de alto impacto.
• Atuar como sponsor em contas-chave e projetos estratégicos.3. Gestão e Desenvolvimento do Time de Vendas
• Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar o desempenho do time de vendas externas.
• Definir metas, acompanhar indicadores e realizar feedbacks contínuos.
• Promover cultura de alta performance, disciplina comercial e foco em resultados.4. Gestão de Pipeline, Receita e KPIs
• Garantir previsibilidade de receita por meio da gestão ativa do pipeline de vendas.
• Monitorar e reportar KPIs como:
• Receita gerada em campo
• Taxa de conversão por etapa do funil
• Ticket médio e ciclo de vendas
• Forecast accuracy
• Expansão e retenção de contas estratégicas5. Relacionamento com Mercado e Interface Interna
• Atuar como representante da Mobiis junto a clientes estratégicos, eventos e encontros de mercado.
• Trabalhar de forma integrada com Pré-vendas, Marketing, Produto e Customer Success.
• Levar insights do mercado, concorrência e clientes para evolução da estratégia comercial e do portfólio.Requisitos Obrigatórios
▪ Experiência sólida como Gerente de Vendas em Campo ou posições equivalentes em vendas externas.
▪ Forte atuação em vendas B2 B, preferencialmente em tecnologia ou soluções complexas.
▪ Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes comerciais externas.
▪ Capacidade avançada de negociação, fechamento e relacionamento em nível executivo (C-level). ▪ Forte orientação a resultados, métricas e previsibilidade de receita.
▪ Experiência com CRM e metodologias de vendas consultivas.
▪ Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.Requisitos Desejáveis
▪ Vivência em Saa S, tecnologia logística ou cadeia de suprimentos (TMS, WMS, YMS, OMS, Torre de Controle).
▪ Experiência em vendas de soluções de alto valor agregado e contratos de longo prazo.
▪ Inglês intermediário/avançado.
▪ Experiência em estratégias de expansão de contas.
▪ Perfil analítico, estratégico e com forte presença em campo.A Quem Ele Deve se Reportar
O Gerente de Vendas Campo se reportará diretamente ao Diretor de Vendas e Estratégia Comercial, atuando de forma integrada com Marketing, Pré-vendas, Produto e Customer Success.

title: Custom recruitment specialist (english & german speaking)
description:
About M3:A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.
Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for aCustom Recruitment Specialistto join M3 Global Research, an M3 company.
About the Business Unit:M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.
M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.
Job Description
TheCustom Recruitment Specialistis responsible for creating and executing a Custom Recruitment plan on allocated M3 Experts projects, as well as traditional Qualitative and Quantitative market research projects, ensuring a successful delivery within the provided budget and timelines. This role will directly manage expert and respondent facing recruitment tasks with the aim of increasing the total number of consultations and/or market research completes. This position will also utilize language capabilities as needed to expand the supply of experts primarily in Germany, but also globally.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:Including, but not limited to the following:
Have an excellent understanding of custom recruitment strategies for M3 Experts studies, as well as traditional qualitative and quantitative studies; collaborate with Project Stakeholders to best utilize available options for maximum results.
Demonstrate complete confidence in using all recruitment platforms and tools, such as the MR System, Dotmailer, Call Center, Linked In, Click Send, DNUK, Rekru, Confirmit/Decipher…
Attend IKO and project related meetings with PMs for projects assigned and share notes on agreed plan of action.
Build a custom recruitment plan for assigned projects always keeping in mind the needs of the client
Custom recruit for the expansion of M3’s global Expert Network via current client projects and strategic proactive recruitment initiatives.
Expand our network of Germany based experts and German speaking experts to meet current and future client demand.
Manage the full lifecycle of custom recruitment for all project types, ensuring successful delivery within the budget provided and timelines.
Communicate and collaborate across teams and divisions, including Qual, Quant and Sales.Qualifications
Education and Training Required:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred
Relevant coursework in market research or healthcare preferred but not required.
Language:Fluency inEnglishandGerman(professional working proficiency)
Minimum Experience:Minimum 2 years’ expert network, market research or recruiting experience
Prior experience managing client or expert relationships a plus
Knowledge, Skill, Ability:Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc
Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitaskAdditional Information

title: Líder de equipe comercial externo - mercado pago - rs

title: Network engineer commissioning specialist (bsc/rnc), oss and sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client's technical requirements.Responsibilities:
(Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.Technical Requirements:
Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G networks.
Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.Desired Profile:
Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
Proactive and collaborative attitude.Education:
Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Data scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.
Purpose of the Job
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.Key Responsibilities:
Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
Develop, implement, and optimize statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs to address business needs, especially in pricing and sales forecasting.
Collaborate with the Global BI Team and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.Required Qualifications:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., Tensor Flow, Py Torch).
Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Government relations director, brazil
description:
SHEINFounded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,
Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumersin more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and
lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help
everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their
individuality through access to the latest trends.SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,
collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to
come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and
enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making
it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.Summary of Role
The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing
assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business
interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key
stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to
advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,
organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in
support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry
associations and other public arenas.In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance
SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to
understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.Job Responsibilities
Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platformsRequired Qualifications and Experience
Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Senior data scientist
description:
About CredixCredixis a Fin Tech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2 B transactions in Brazil with our platform,Credi Pay. Credi Pay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.Why choose Credix?
Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.About the job
We’re looking for aSenior Data Scientistto join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:
Who gets funded
How and when we collect
Where we allocate risk capital
You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency.
Your focus:deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.Specifically, you will:
Model borrower risk: Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
Detect and prevent fraud: Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
Prioritize recovery actions: Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we knowwhoto contact,how, andwhen.
Design experiments: Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
Deploy your work: Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
Create leverage: Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.
What We’re Looking For
5+ yearsof experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
Strong command ofSQL,Python, and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.
Nice to have:
Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).
Languages:
Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).What we offer
Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:
A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Especialista de modelagem hidráulica pleno
description:
A AegeaCriada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Principais Responsabilidades
Conduzir autonomamente estudos hidráulicos para sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário.
Elaborar e validar documentação técnica de estudos internos e de terceiros.
Desenvolver análises, cenários críticos e estudos de ampliação em sistemas de água e esgoto.
Executar e validar calibrações de modelos hidráulicos com base em dados monitorados.
Participar da análise de viabilidade econômica de soluções técnicas de infraestrutura.
Atuar em demandas de novos negócios da companhia, com foco técnico na modelagem.
Integrar informações de campo e dados geoespaciais (GIS) aos modelos.
Contribuir em grupos de trabalho e iniciativas de evolução técnica da área.
Requisitos
Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Sanitária, Ambiental ou correlatas.
Experiência prática em modelagem hidráulica (construção, calibração, setorização, cenários e ampliação).
Domínio de softwares como Water CAD, Sewer CAD, Hammer, Epanet ou similares.
Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel.
Conhecimento em GIS (QGIS ou Arc GIS).
Experiência com projetos de saneamento.
Capacidade analítica, organização, proatividade e comunicação eficaz.
Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.
Diferenciais
Experiência com sistemas de monitoramento de redes.
Vivência com equipes multidisciplinares e interfaces operacionais.
Informações adicionais:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.

title: Executivo de contas sênior em farmer para big sellers - mercado pago
description:
No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em gênero, religião, pessoas com deficiência, LGBTQI+, etnia, gerações e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa.Estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.
Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários (as).
Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.
Para milhões de comércios, empreendimentos e profissões, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.
Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.
Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades das pessoas para as quais prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:
Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites;Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação;Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros;A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas;Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe..
Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:
Promover excelência de relacionamento com uma carteira de clientes big sellers com alto faturamento mensal;Acompanhar principais KPIs da carteira, tendo rotinas de análises sobre índices de chargeback, exposição ao risco, TPV mensal e diário, ticket médio, etc;Promover upselle cross-sell da carteira, construindo um pipeline consistente M+2;Presencialidadenos sellers com foco em relacionamento com decisores conforme cluster definidos pela liderança;Ownership de frentes táticas importantes para o desenvolvimento de engagement & growth com demais áreas pares;Disponibilidade para vir ao escritório sempre que necessário (Melicidade).Requisitos:
Possuir formação Superior Completa;Possuir experiência em áreas comerciais e de negócios;Possuir experiência no mercado financeiro, fintech e meios de pagamentos;Possuir inglês avançado (escrita / conversação);Possuir conhecimento analítico, será considerado como diferencial.Nós lhe propomos:
Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo;Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores;Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas;Experimentar umexcelente clima de trabalho, com o necessário para viver a grande experiência de trabalhar num lugar eleito, em diversas categorias, como Great Place to Work.

title: Gerente geral
description:
Gerente de Franquia de Soroterapia e Estética
Visão Geral do Cargo:O Gerente de uma franquia é o profissional responsável porgerenciar a operação da unidade, garantindo a excelência no atendimento, o cumprimento de metas financeiras e a motivação da equipe. Ele atua como um elo entre a franqueadora e a unidade franqueada, assegurando que os padrões da marca sejam seguidos e que a empresa opere com eficiência e lucratividade.Principais Funções e Responsabilidades:Gestão Operacional e Administrativa:
• Supervisionartoda a operação da unidade, garantindo que os processos e protocolos da franquia sejam seguidos corretamente.
• Monitorarestoques, insumos e equipamentos, garantindo que tudo esteja adequado para os atendimentos.
• Acompanharagendamentos e fluxo de atendimento, assegurando a melhor experiência para os clientes.
• Garantir que a clínica esteja sempre organizada, limpa e dentro dospadrões exigidos pela franqueadora.Gestão Comercial e Financeira:
• Acompanhar odesempenho financeiroda unidade, analisando faturamento, custos e lucratividade.
• Definir e acompanharmetas de vendaspara a equipe, garantindo o crescimento da unidade.
• Implementarestratégias de retenção e captação de clientes, incluindo campanhas promocionais e parcerias.
• Garantir que os clientes tenham umatendimento excepcionale retornem para novos serviços.Gestão de Equipe:
• Coordenarrecepcionistas, consultores de vendas e equipe técnica (médicos, nutricionistas, etc.).
•Treinar e motivar a equipepara atingimento de metas e excelência no atendimento.
• Acompanhardesempenho individual e coletivo, dando feedbacks e promovendo melhoria contínua.
• Resolver conflitos internos, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo.Relacionamento com Clientes e Qualidade de Atendimento:
• Garantirexperiência diferenciada para os clientes, acompanhando desde o agendamento até o pós-atendimento.
• Implementar estratégias paraaumentar a fidelização e satisfação dos clientes.
• Monitorar reclamações e sugestões, buscando sempre amelhoria contínua dos serviços.Remuneração, Premiação e ComissãoRemuneração:
•Salário R$ 4.000,00.
Vale-transporte e vale alimentação: R$ 1.000,00.Horário: segunda à sexta-feira, de 09 às 19 h. Sábado 09 às 13h.Bônus e Premiação:
•Bônus por Meta.Perfil Ideal para o Cargo:
•Formação: Administração, Gestão Comercial, Estética ou áreas correlatas (não obrigatório, mas desejável).
•Experiência prévia: Mínimo de1 a 3 anos em gestão de negócios, coordenação de equipe ou vendas em estética, saúde ou franquias.
•Habilidades: Liderança, comunicação, foco em resultados, gestão de pessoas e organização.
•Disponibilidade

title: General manager operations
description:
About the CompanyHello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.Our promise to you:-We will respect and value your background and perspectives
-We will work together with integrity
-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industryWhat we ask of you:-Bring passion to all that you do
-Listen, move fast and think innovatively
-Speak up, have ideas, and share them
-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindnessAs industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.Who we are:We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.About the job:The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.Operational Management:
Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.Financial Management:
Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.Job Requirements:Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
Willingness to travel frequently within the region
Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy
